create_shutterstock3d_dataset: create a Shutterstock3DDataset instance to load multi-view images from a Shutterstock 3D folder
iterate_shutterstock3d_samples: iterate over Shutterstock3DDataset to yield batches of ray origins, directions, and images
get_multi_view_dataset_iter: get a multi-view dataset iterator from a folder using NerfstudioDataParser and PatchPixelSampler
get_total_samples: get the total number of samples available in the Shutterstock3DDataset
augment_rays_and_cameras: augment ray origins and directions using random rotation and scaling transformations
